crossRefs.note: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.
“Therefore Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘I said indeed that your house and the house of your father should walk…
You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry; behold, my servants will drink…
Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and…

translations.web: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
translations.bsb: The wise will inherit honor, but fools are held up to shame.
translations.kjv: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
translations.asv: The wise shall inherit glory; But shame shall be the promotion of fools.
